    • How does Night Shred™ work?

      Night Shred™ attacks stubborn fat and puffiness from three angles simultaneously: cortisol reduction, deep sleep, and overnight thermogenesis. KSM-66® Ashwagandha cuts cortisol — the stress hormone that drives belly fat storage and facial puffiness. GABA and Melatonin drive you into the deep NREM sleep stages where your body clears fluid retention, resets hormones, and activates real fat burning. And Paradoxine® activates Brown Adipose Tissue to burn calories passively while you sleep — turning 8 hours of rest into 8 hours of active fat loss.

    • Is it easy to use?

      Absolutely. Just take two small capsules 30 minutes before bed with a glass of water. No messy powders, no complicated timing, no 4 AM wake-ups. For best results, take consistently every night — even on non-training days — so cortisol stays suppressed and your overnight fat-burning window stays open.

    • What fat areas does it target?

      Night Shred™ is specifically formulated for the stubborn fat areas driven by cortisol — the midsection, the lower belly, and the facial puffiness that shows up in the mirror every morning. By shutting down cortisol overnight and activating BAT thermogenesis during deep sleep, Night Shred™ helps your body release fat from the exact places stress has been forcing it to store.

    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

    • How many bottles should I order?

      We recommend taking Night Shred™ consistently for at least 90–180 days to support your weight management goals over time.*† The three keystone ingredients — KSM-66®, Paradoxine®, and melatonin — are each backed by human studies showing effects with consistent daily use.* Many users notice a difference in sleep quality within the first few nights.*†

    • Is Night Shred™ safe?

      Night Shred™ is made with natural, non-GMO ingredients and manufactured to the highest quality standards. With over 500,000 bottles sold, Night Shred™ has an excellent safety record. Every capsule is manufactured in the USA in an FDA-registered, cGMP-certified facility under strict quality controls.* Night Shred™ is also vegan-friendly. As always, if you have a medical condition or take medications, consult your doctor before use.*

    • Where is this product manufactured?

      Night Shred™ is manufactured in and ships from the USA.*

    • I have trouble sleeping, will this help me sleep better?

      Our sleep complex is built around 3mg melatonin — supported by a meta-analysis of 19 RCTs for reducing sleep-onset latency and improving sleep quality* — plus 375mg GABA, shown in human studies to promote relaxation and support faster sleep onset.* Valerian root and passionflower round out the calming complex, and 5-HTP supports healthy serotonin production — the body's natural calm-and-sleep precursor.*

    • Is Night Shred™ vegan?

      Night Shred™ is certified vegan, we use veggie capsules for this product!*

    • Will Night Shred™ show up on a drug test?

      While our products do not contain PEDs, we recommend checking over the label with your regulating commitee before taking any supplement.*
